title: Installation, inspection, repair, maintenance, adjustment, use, and removal of scaffolds.
officialText:
Scaffolds shall be installed,
inspected, repaired, maintained, adjusted, used, and removed in accordance with the specifications of the manufacturer, where such
specifications exist, and the requirements of Sections 3314.4.1 through 3314.4.8.
